question: Let $\vec{a} = a_1\hat{i} + a_2\hat{j} + a_3\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b} = b_1\hat{i} + b_2\hat{j} + b_3\hat{k}$ such that $|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = 3$, and $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 2$. Find $|\vec{a} + \vec{b}|$ and $|\vec{a} - \vec{b}|$ and then evaluate $|\vec{a} + \vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{a} - \vec{b}|^2$.
